ruling: EXCLUDE (zero credit). The refutation of Conjecture 35 is mathematically correct for all m >= 3, but it is assembled from the authors' own ingredients: the W1 obstruction (Theorem 19(b)), the 'exactly one of two cross arcs' counting (Proposition 12) and the companion paper's padding technique (arXiv:2003.02107, Proposition 23). The new content is the attachment choice and a four-line p3 case. Consistent with precedents 364079, 369221, 371637 and 374241 (source-ingredient bridges). The reviewer's mitigating points (uniqueness of the working attachment among 47,604 configurations; W2 and dense paddings fail; the p3 case lies outside Theorem 19(b)) are search facts, not a substantive new argument.
